verdict.rationale: Wrangler CLI provides full create/dev/deploy/rollback commands scriptable in CI (cloudflare-docs-11, cloudflare-docs-20, cloudflare-docs-23, cloudflare-probe-3), Cloudflare explicitly documents fitting into 'Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code' workflows (cloudflare-docs-17), and API tokens with scoped permissions support headless/CI automation including MCP server access via bearer tokens 'for CI/CD or automation' (cloudflare-docs-14, cloudflare-docs-21, cloudflare-supp-codemode-mcp). Community corroborates CLI-driven deploy workflows (cloudflare-comm-3). missing for 10: a first-party CI/CD case study or GitHub Actions template walkthrough, and independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI runs beyond docs claims.
